shorts_extract.hook: Why does 10 seconds of a grocery-store song loop inside your head for four hours — and how does plain chewing gum shut it off?
shorts_extract.core_experiment: Philip Beaman's 2015 Reading chewing-gum vs finger-tapping trial (-33% earworms) + Jakubowski's 3,000-person 124-bpm anatomy study.
shorts_extract.twist: Stuck songs aren't just in your ears — your throat and jaw planner silently sings them, AND spontaneous replay helps file life memories!
